name: Deep Learning
description: PyTorch backend and CUDA availability check. Training workflows are extension points, not pretrained models.

description: Image preprocessing and computer-vision benchmark tools. Enable OpenCV from requirements-optional.txt.

name: Robotics
description: Interactive robot-arm concept view and a simple two-link planar forward-kinematics endpoint.

name: CAD
description: Parametric geometry preview. This is not a full CAD kernel or STEP editor.

name: CAE
description: Engineering result visualization and post-processing workflows.

name: FEA
status: exported-result post-processing API; beam theory calculator added
description: Analyze exported nodal displacement and von Mises stress. Not a finite-element solver.

name: CFD
status: velocity-field post-processing API; no CFD solver
description: Illustrative vector-field visualization. Connect a CFD solver export for real simulation results.

name: Topology Optimization
description: Illustrative density/lattice view. No SIMP optimization solve is performed by this demo.

name: Data Science
description: Data profiling, cleaning, statistics and benchmark visualization.

name: Beam Lab
description: Simply-supported beam with full-span UDL or midspan point load; optional elastic deflection estimate.

name: Materials Library
description: Typical density, Young's modulus, yield strength and Poisson ratio for selected common alloys; verify certified datasheets.

name: Shaft Design
description: Elastic torsional shear stress and angle-of-twist calculator for a solid circular shaft.

name: Fatigue Analysis
description: Calculate Goodman utilization and nominal factor of safety from stress amplitude, mean stress, endurance limit and ultimate strength.

name: Engineering Unit Converter
description: Convert length, force, pressure, mass, energy, power, speed and temperature units.

name: Design of Experiments
description: Generate full-factorial low/high experiment matrices with optional center-point repeats.
